context: Banchi cannot always tell a card's printing from the photo. All screens, both Duo sizes and themes: https://claude.ai/artifact/F2pNQsrFg6fDSqFQzKpasU (picks page) and designs/d4-banchi-phone/ on the roadmap branch. All cards, orders and buyers are made up.

options.gain: The card is still in hand.
options.how: The app stops on each unsure card.
options.label: During the sitting
options.lose: Breaks "zero attention per card"; the stack waits.

options.gain: The sitting never stops; nothing is guessed.
options.how: Unsure cards go to one pile, settled together at the end.
options.label: After, in a pile
options.lose: The seller may need to find the card again (its place is shown).

options.label: Never by hand
options.lose: Unsure cards are often the valuable printings, and they never get listed.

ref: d4 (first design test: a blind Banchi phone app)
title: Banchi phone app: when does the seller settle the cards Banchi is not sure of?
why: Designer and reviewer both pick B: it keeps the sitting moving and guesses nothing.
